lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: All right. The new envelope. Nine takes on the board Friday night, and they get opened next September. But we can talk about them now, O'Dog. Let's start with hockey.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Chris put up Gavin McKenna. Points, rookie season. Nick 48. Jay 49. Justin 55. Chris 62.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: 62 for an 18 year old. Chris watched one Penn State highlight and lost his mind. I like the kid. I really don't like 62.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Then Matthews. Goals. After the 27. Nick 40. Jay 34. Justin 36. Chris 42.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Look at that. A year ago they had him at 48. Now the high man is 42 and the low man is 34. That's a room that got burned, Hayesy. They learned something.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Jay put up Bobrovsky. Wins. Nick 30. Jay 19. Justin 29. Chris 21.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: 19 wins for Bob. Jay's got him retiring at Christmas. The man's got two Cups and he turns 38 tomorrow. 19. Buddy.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: And Nick's own take. How many points do the Leafs get. The line is 88 and a half. Nick 92. Jay 91. Justin 90. Chris 100.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: 100! 100 points for a team that got 27 goals out of Matthews last year. Chris, 95 percent of the time, possibly higher, that team does not deserve the benefit of the doubt. You know that.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Written down. Sealed. We read it back next September.
